I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and fonts are unchecked.

- **Layout:** The screen is 1280px wide inside `#component`, on white. Content is one centered column of up to 1120px, with 48px above it and 32px at the sides. The heading "NOTIFICATIONS" is on the left in Unbounded Light capitals. "Mark All as Read" is on the right as the screen's single primary button, an ink pill 44px tall.
- **List:** The six notifications sit in one bordered card with 52px rows and light dividers. Unread items have a blue dot and bold ink text. Read items have muted text and a blank space where the dot would be, so the text lines up. Each time is right-aligned.
- **Following DESIGN.md:** Colors, spacing, radius, tracking and font sizes all use its tokens. I copied only the tokens I needed from `tokens.css` into the file so it stands alone. There are no hardcoded hex values in the component styles.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so the file names them and falls back to the system font. In a browser without them installed, the heading will look different from the intended design.
- **Unread state:** The unread dot is aria-hidden. A screen reader won't announce which items are unread, because adding text for it would change your exact content.
- **Row size:** Rows are 52px and the text is 14px, as the "Tables and lists" rule says. I stuck to that over making them roomier.
